as_uploaded.rule: olfdb dataset 8 as uploaded; the single trials of each stimulus's first block for the noise

first_presentations.rule: every stimulus's first presentation of the session; the noise SD from the first blocks, n = 1

components_first_block.rule: every stimulus's first block (the uploaded table's trials)

components_second_block.rule: the components' second block where there is one, else their first; the mixtures' block

components_both_blocks.rule: the components' two blocks together where there are two, else the first; the mixtures' block

units.noise: baseline-noise units on megamat's footing: Remy's mean_peak Fc (2 to 8 s mean minus -5 to 0 s mean) over the RMS over the session's trials of her per-trial baseline SD (baseline_std file), times the footing factor

criteria.source: the E134 lock's soma_criteria (megamat's level; the mixtures' z bridge)

footing.rule: the 'noise' units times megamat's median noise bridge over the median of the mixture flies' bridges (one group: FOOTING_GROUPS)

noise_rule: the flies' single-trial residual SD about each cell's block mean, pooled over the panel's flies, cells, stimuli and the reading's blocks (n / (n - 1)); added to a model value over sqrt(n), n the trials the reading averages for the stimulus

classes.stage_rule: inside if the family's strength error is at or below the flies' most atypical fly on strength on 6 of 8 wirings; far if above 2 on 6 of 8; else between
classes.readable: a mixture panel is readable on strength if the family's class is the same under the four position readings
classes.replaces: a reading replaces the lock's where the panel is readable under it and the reproduction holds
classes.v2_readable: validation2 is readable if the class is the same on the six flies and on all twenty under both rules
